theme: Named architectural systems linked to building episodes and dated deposits
question: Which original sections and deposit descriptions link Lothal dock and Dholavira castle and middle-town walls to building episodes?
outcome: Eleven relations from 24 pages in two held excavation scans record inward additions, separate enclosure starts, inlet replacements and later sealing fill. No construction sample joins, new bearings or new determinations.
challenge: Composite plans, restored faces and phase-level dates do not identify the dated construction of each measured line; source text has a street-direction conflict.
remedy: Preserve exact page locators and physical relationships; separate initial wall, repairs and redeposited fill; require phase-keyed survey and original sample contexts.
retry_when: Obtain phase-keyed wall plans, surveyed true-north control and sample loci in primary construction deposits; recover original TF-19 context and TL laboratory records.
